title: Scheduled Suomi Herää / Independence Day marches cancelled before 6 December
exclusion_reason: Yle reports on 2 December that the Suomi Herää event was cancelled following a regional restriction; Helsinki without Nazis and 612 marches were also called off. These planned demonstrations are not executed events.

occurrence_status.summary: Yle reports cancellation of the named plans; no event occurrence is assigned.

title: Small groups at Töölöntori on Independence Day
exclusion_reason: Yle reports separate groups of about 10 nationalists and about 20 Helsinki without Nazis participants, with rapid dispersal; below the 50-person threshold for each described gathering.

participants.summary: Police/account gives roughly 10-person groups; Yle reporter saw about 20 counter-demonstrators; torch procession had only a few participants. No 50-person gathering supported.

title: Indian diaspora protest in Helsinki in support of Indian farmers
exclusion_reason: The accessed report says no more than 10 people could gather at one time and reports >50 only cumulatively over time, which does not establish a 50-person gathering. It also describes demands directed to the Government of India and Indian farm laws, not Finnish state policy; codebook excludes such foreign-government-targeted action.

date.summary: The event occurred 8 December 2020 from 16:00 for two hours.

location.summary: In front of the Finnish Parliament, Helsinki.

participants.summary: The report says more than 50 were present at different times, but police permission allowed only 10 at one time; the cumulative total is not a crowd size.

demands.summary: Called for repeal of Indian farm laws and condemned violence against farmers in India.

state_target.summary: Demand targeted the Government of India, not Finnish government/state policy.
